### Highlights

#### 🎯 Your agent, your map, your score

Valorant tells Discord you're playing Valorant. That's where it stops.

- Your agent's portrait fills the status during a match, and your player card sits there between them.
- Your rank emblem shows in competitive, with the tier on hover.
- Map, queue and the round score follow along as the game moves.

#### ✍️ Every line is yours to write

Six situations, each with its own template and its own default.

- In client, in lobby, in queue, custom game, agent select and in a match.
- Write your own wording with `{agent}`, `{map}`, `{mode}`, `{party}` and `{score}`.
- Rank, match detail and deathmatch kills each turn off on their own, and any template resets to its default.

#### 🔄 Updates that check themselves before installing

- Every release ships a checksum file signed with a key whose public half is compiled into the app.
- An update that arrives without a valid signature is refused rather than installed.
- Install from About, or get a notification when a version lands.

#### 🖥️ Runs quietly

- Closing the window leaves it in the tray, and it can start with Windows already minimized.
- Light and dark themes, following the system by default.
- Runs next to League RPC without either one getting in the other's way.
